fields.title: Aequs Aerospace CNC & Precision Engineering Track
fields.eligibility_criteria: Degree / Diploma in Mechanical / Production Engineering with >= 65% aggregate.
fields.description: Comprehensive practical industrial training on 5-Axis CNC machining, GD&T blueprint analysis, precision aerospace milling, and CMM quality inspections.

fields.title: Quality Assurance & Aerospace Metrology Track
fields.eligibility_criteria: B.Sc / Diploma / Degree in Mechanical, Electronics, or Industrial Physics.
fields.description: Hands-on calibration, coordinate measuring machines (CMM), surface roughness profiling, and AS9100 quality compliance documentation.

fields.title: Industrial IoT & Smart Factory IT Operations
fields.eligibility_criteria: B.E. Computer Science / BCA / IT Diploma students with knowledge of Python & SQL.
fields.description: Smart sensor telemetry, factory floor MES integration, real-time dashboarding, and shopfloor predictive maintenance pipelines.

fields.title: Supply Chain & Aerospace Logistics Track
fields.eligibility_criteria: B.Com / BBA / Logistics Diploma scholars with good analytical skills.
fields.description: Raw material procurement workflows, ERP SAP inventory tracking, export documentation, and customs compliance for SEZ operations.

fields.title: Tool & Die Design & Additive Prototyping
fields.eligibility_criteria: Tool & Die Diploma or NTTF / GTTC certified candidates.
fields.description: Injection molding tool design, press tools, NX CAD/CAM surfacing, and rapid additive metal sintering prototyping.

fields.project_title: Optimizing High-Speed CNC Toolpaths for Titanium Aerospace Brackets
fields.evaluation_feedback: Demonstrates exceptional spatial comprehension and precision cutting tool setup skills on Mori Seiki 5-axis machines.

fields.project_title: Automated Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) Inspection Calibration
fields.evaluation_feedback: Flawless calibration logs and thorough understanding of Zeiss Calypso metrology software routines.

fields.project_title: ERP Inventory Lead-Time Optimization for Raw Ingot Logistics
fields.evaluation_feedback: Successfully delivered an automated vendor re-order dashboard in SAP reducing stockout risk by 35%. Completed internship with top honors.

fields.project_title: Surface Finish Roughness Enhancement in Aluminum Turbine Impellers
fields.evaluation_feedback: Quick learner, currently completing introductory safety protocols and CAD blueprint verification.

fields.title: Phase 2: Live Machine Setup & Blueprint Tolerancing Practice

fields.quote: Teaching high school students robotics and hands-on manufacturing at the Science Centre showed me how our everyday engineering skills can ignite young minds.
Volunteering with the Aequs Foundation for the Mobile Science Lab allowed us to bring real aerospace precision parts to rural classrooms. The excitement on students' faces was unforgettable.
Through AEQATRA, our team has dedicated over 40 hours to student mentoring. Giving back through STEM education is one of the most rewarding parts of working at Aequs.
